title: Actions++
description: in this mod-pack (Actions++) it adds stuff like the way you hold your items, 3d items, player animations and mob animations, but the thing that Minecraft misses the most is particles, in this mod-pack it also adds particles like water   particles and fire.
body:
in this mod-pack (Actions++) it adds every thing you need to make it _feel_ like better minecraft


#  Features: 
### Particles:
- fire🔥
- water🌊
- sparkles( when minecarts are on rails)🎇
- fireflies
- 3d splashes💦
- bubbles🫧
- popping bubbles🫧
- cave dust
- bubbles from underwater chests and barrels🫧
- cake eating particels🍰
- lava drops🔥


### Animations:
- Mob Animations
- Player Animations
- Items animation (like when you swing your sword)
- skelton death animations or any mob that looks like a skelton (Ex: Wither)🦴



###   3D Stuff:
- Brush 
- shears
- food🍎
- buckets🪣
- plants🌻
- campfires
- flower pots🪴
